disclaimer: Company-level path from funding and land to a sold kilogram of Dy, then magnets, recycle, royalties, and closure. Not a feasibility study, not investment advice, not affiliated with USA Rare Earth or TMRC. Status is reviewed when new public research lands. Adjacent-chain items (Serra Verde, Stillwater magnets) are labeled so they are not mistaken for Round Top Dy sales.
review_hooks: Wheat Ridge published a Round Top-ore Dy mass balance (not just swarf)?
Any Round Top-specific offtake or Dy price floor?
Current Dy oxide price vs $250 China-band and $575 Serra floor

stages.name: Corporate control
stages.when: JV since 2018; TMRC buyout announced Mar 2026
stages.cash: TMRC stub ~$73M in USAR shares (company); Serra Verde closed Sep 2026 at $300M cash + ~126.8M shares — adjacent mine, not Round Top
stages.what: Round Top sits in Round Top Mountain Development. Year-end 2025 split was USAR 81.3% / TMRC 18.7%. March 2026 merger agreement aims to make USAR 100% operator and economic owner. Serra Verde (Pela Ema, Brazil) closed 3 Sep 2026 and feeds the same metal/magnet chain, but it is not this Texas rhyolite.
stages.dy: Without 100% control, a Dy plant decision is still a JV decision.
stages.next: Confirm TMRC close and any leftover minority or royalty carve-outs.

stages.name: Obtain funding
stages.when: PIPE 28 Jan 2026; CHIPS definitive 3 Jun 2026; Texas SIF May 2026
stages.cash: PIPE $1.5B equity; CHIPS up to $277M grant + $1.3B 15-yr loan (T+150 bps, milestone draws); Texas SIF $14.2M; DOE CMI $19.3M selection. Loans and equity are not profit.
stages.what: Cash arrives before rock moves. CHIPS money is tied to Round Top design / early works / SX / construction milestones (Dec 2026–Dec 2028) and to magnet-plant milestones. Commerce also takes stock and a warrant. Q2 2026 cash was about $1.53B before the $300M Serra check.
stages.dy: Grants cut capex in the P/L tab. They do not buy a Dy offtake or a price floor for Round Top oxide.
stages.next: Did a CHIPS draw fund? Did DOE CMI leave ‘selection’ and become cash?

stages.name: Mineral leases (not a fee-simple mine)
stages.when: M-113117 Sep 2011; M-113629 Nov 2011; both renewable
stages.cash: Delay rentals ~$179k/yr on the big lease for 2025–2029; leftover lease bonus $97.8k due with a supplemental mining plan
stages.what: The mountain is Texas state land. Two GLO mining leases cover about 950 acres authorized for mining (860 + 90). Term runs to 2030 and then as long as minerals are produced in paying quantities. This is a lease, not a land purchase.
stages.dy: Dy is an ‘other mineral’ on these leases. You cannot sell it without the lease in force.

stages.name: Surface rights, option to buy land, water
stages.when: Surface option 2014; company and GLO still negotiating exercise (2026 filings)
stages.cash: Option kept alive at $10k/yr; purchase price = appraised surface value at exercise (unknown $). Groundwater: $5k/yr before use, then $0.95 per thousand gallons or $20k/yr. Company already owns ~2,037 acres of process land.
stages.what: Heaps and a plant need surface, not just mineral rights. 5,670-acre purchase option covers the 950-acre mine block plus ~4,720 acres for heaps and plant. ~55,000-acre surface lease SL2004002 (to 23 Nov 2028) is grazing land with a preference right to buy and a path to wind/groundwater with GLO approval. Groundwater lease is a few miles away. CHIPS papers list exercising the GLO surface option as a condition.
stages.dy: No liner, no heap, no Dy liquor. Water is the cheap reagent carrier.
stages.next: Did they exercise the surface option? Appraised $ / acre?

stages.name: Permits and baseline
stages.when: Stormwater coverage in hand; operating suite still ahead
stages.owner: RTMD / TCEQ / county; federal if funding or discharge triggers it
stages.what: Public list so far: TCEQ construction stormwater TXR150000 and a SWPPP. Later expect air, process-water discharge, waste, petroleum tanks, radioactive-equipment registration, and a reclamation plan. State land avoids BLM, but NEPA can still attach to federal money or federal permits. Heap liquor will carry fluoride plus some U and Th.
stages.dy: A missing discharge or radiation permit stops the plant even if the SX works.
stages.next: Published mine operating-permit matrix and any contested case.

stages.name: Studies: PEA → PFS → DFS
stages.when: 2019 PEA done; PFS 2H 2026; DFS complete Q4 2026 / publish Q1 2027 (company plan)
stages.cash: 2019 PEA initial capex $350.4M at 20,000 tpd. 2012 80,000 tpd study (~$2B) is a different flowsheet.
stages.what: A PEA is a sketch. The Accelerated Mining Plan pulled commercial start from 2030 to late 2028 after 2025 SX pilots. PFS then DFS turn Wheat Ridge hours into a plant design and a bankable cost book. Until DFS is public, every P/L number on this site is a sketch.
stages.dy: DFS is the first document that can put a real $/kg on Round Top Dy2O3.

stages.name: Engineers and early works
stages.when: Fluor + WSP on PFS; geotech / confirmatory drilling H1 2026
stages.cash: unknown (company-level capex, not a published EPCM contract value)
stages.what: Somebody has to design pads, liners, ponds, crush, and the SX hall, then order long-lead tanks. CHIPS lists ‘early works’ as a funded milestone.
stages.dy: Wrong pad or pond design leaks F/U/Th and kills the permit.
stages.next: Public early-works start or long-lead PO.

stages.name: Wheat Ridge demonstration plant
stages.when: 99.1% Dy2O3 sample Jan 2025; plant commissioned Jun 2026; first oxides targeted Q3 2026
stages.owner: USAR hydromet, Wheat Ridge CO (lease to Mar 2028)
stages.cash: Pilot/demo envelope company-described as up to ~$50M at one stage; exact spend unpublished
stages.what: This is the kitchen, not the mountain. Three campaigns: Round Top ore, third-party MREC (including Pela Ema), and magnet swarf. Public envelope is five SX circuits and more than 500 mixer-settlers. Recipe is secret. July 2026 produced commercial-grade NdPr and Dy oxide from Stillwater swarf.
stages.dy: Proves Round Top rock can yield magnet-grade Dy oxide. Does not prove heap recovery or $/kg at 20,000 tpd.
stages.next: Published Round Top-ore campaign mass balance, not only swarf.

stages.name: Build the mine and heap
stages.when: Construction after DFS; commercial production targeted late 2028
stages.cash: 2019 PEA $350.4M initial at 20 kt/d; later decks talk 40 kt/d by 2030. Real DFS number unknown.
stages.what: Crush rhyolite, stack on a lined pad, drip dilute sulfuric acid, collect pregnant liquor. Most of the mountain is dead quartz and feldspar. Patent columns on this rock got about 57.5% of the Dy on a 1/2-inch crush. That is a column, not a plant guarantee.
stages.dy: This is the only step that creates new Round Top Dy atoms.
stages.next: First liner / pad photo or construction notice.

stages.name: Clean liquor, split Dy, make oxide
stages.when: On-site commercial plant with the mine; demo path already running in Colorado
stages.cash: Inside the plant capex. Method-by-method $ unknown.
stages.what: Heap water carries Dy plus lots of yttrium, fluoride, and some U/Th. Cleanup, then solvent extraction (PC88A / D2EHPA class), then oxalate and bake to Dy2O3. Comparison tab ranks those unit operations. Company also talks a later U.S. MREC / toll plant.
stages.dy: If the split fails, there is no saleable Dy even if the heap worked.
stages.next: Extractant names and stage map, or a DFS process chapter.

stages.name: Sell (or consume) dysprosium oxide
stages.when: Round Top Dy sales not before late-2028 plan; demo/swarf kg already exist
stages.cash: China-band Dy oxide ~$250/kg (2026 print used on the P/L tab). Serra Verde SPV floor $575/kg is Brazil offtake, not a Round Top contract.
stages.what: Two doors: sell Dy2O3 to someone else, or send it down the hall to make metal and magnets. There is no public Round Top Dy offtake and no CHIPS price floor on this oxide. World Dy market is small (~2,000 t/yr on a company call). In-house magnets can swallow the mine’s Dy.
stages.dy: This is the sale the P/L tab models. Co-products (Y, Tb, Li, others) still pay most of the 2019 PEA basket.
stages.next: Any Round Top-specific oxide contract or posted price.

stages.name: Metal and alloy (after oxide)
stages.when: LCM closed Nov 2025; Hooton Park bought Jul 2026
stages.owner: Less Common Metals (UK) + planned U.S. / France strip-cast
stages.cash: LCM deal ~$217M (company); Hooton Park ~£7M. Strip-cast targets in decks: U.S. 10,000 tpa class by late 2027.
stages.what: Oxide is not a magnet. Someone reduces it to metal and strip-casts alloy. Until Round Top runs, this step eats third-party metal and recycled oxide.
stages.dy: Dy metal in the alloy is what raises magnet coercivity at high temperature.
stages.next: First kilogram of Dy metal credited to Round Top ore.

stages.name: Make and sell magnets
stages.when: Stillwater Phase 1a commissioned Q1 2026; commercial output Q2 2026; Blacksburg ground-breaking Sep 2026
stages.cash: Blacksburg plant ~$1.2B company figure. Combined U.S. magnet target 10,000 tpa (Stillwater ~3,600, Blacksburg ~6,400).
stages.what: This is where most of the money in a mine-to-magnet story is supposed to show up. Phase 1a targets 600 tpa by Q4 2026. Q2 2026 writeups still said magnet revenue had not started. Qualification with customers is samples → lab tests → product-cycle tests → purchase orders.
stages.dy: High-temp NdFeB grades use Dy/Tb. A magnet sale is not a Round Top oxide sale.
stages.next: First booked magnet revenue; any Dy-content spec in a public PO.

stages.name: Customers and offtake
stages.when: Serra Verde SPV offtake exists; Round Top Dy offtake does not
stages.cash: Pela Ema floors cited $110/kg NdPr, $575/kg Dy, $2,050/kg Tb. DLA forward-purchase writeups ≥$300M / 5 yr. None of that is a Round Top contract.
stages.what: Near-term magnetic rare earths from this company’s Brazil mine are contracted. Round Top Dy is not. Magnet side: confidential MOUs plus an Arnold Magnetic Technologies distribution-style deal (Mar 2026). DFARS limits on Chinese-origin magnets are a demand tailwind, not a PO.
stages.dy: Do not paste the $575 Dy floor onto the Round Top P/L tab.
stages.next: First named Round Top offtaker or magnet PO with a Dy spec.

stages.name: Recycle swarf and end-of-life magnets
stages.when: Jul 2026 Wheat Ridge made Dy2O3 + NdPr oxide from Stillwater swarf
stages.owner: Wheat Ridge + magnet finishing; Carester mentioned as a longer EOL loop
stages.cash: unknown $/kg; company says recycle can cover up to ~30% of future magnetic REO feed
stages.what: Cutting magnets makes dust and scrap (swarf) that still holds Dy. Sending that dust back through SX is a second mine that does not need a new heap. End-of-life motors are a later, harder feed.
stages.dy: Recycled Dy can fill magnets years before Round Top ships oxide.
stages.next: Steady-state swarf kg/yr and recovery, not a one-campaign sample.

stages.name: After sale: royalties to Texas
stages.cash: Minimum advance royalty $500k (M-113117) + $50k (M-113629). Then 6.25% of market value of Dy and other non-fissionable minerals; 8% on uranium / fissionable. 2012 PEA text: royalty = 6.25% × (gross − processing cost), GLO may take in-kind.
stages.what: State land means a slice of every sold kilogram goes to Texas schools. That is a cost after the oxide truck leaves, not a grant.
stages.dy: 6.25% of Dy market value (or net, if the PEA reading still holds) comes off the P/L after a sale.
stages.next: Current lease amendment: gross vs net royalty?

stages.name: After sale: repay the loan, honor the warrant
stages.cash: Up to $1.3B senior loan. Optional 4-year PIK. Commerce ~16.1M shares + warrant for ~17.6M more (LOI/definitive coverage).
stages.what: A loan is not a grant. After magnets and oxide start selling, cash has to service debt and live with a government shareholder. Missing a milestone can stop the next draw.
stages.dy: Debt service can eat Dy-only cash even when the heap works.
stages.next: First CHIPS draw amount and any PIK election.

stages.name: After the last kilogram: close the heap
stages.when: After the 20-year PEA life — or whenever paying quantities stop
stages.what: Lined heaps, fluoride and U/Th residues, residual radioactivity, and water treatment do not leave when the last Dy oxide is sold. Co-products and third-party MREC may keep the plant alive after the Dy grade fades.
stages.dy: Closure cost is a real liability against lifetime Dy P/L and is not in the current sketch model.
